name: Fuel Economy.gov
tagline: EPA fuel economy ratings for US vehicles via free public API
description: Public API from fueleconomy.gov providing EPA fuel economy ratings, vehicle specifications, MPG data, and emissions information for US vehicles. Free to use with no authentication required for standard endpoints.

auth.details: No authentication required for public REST endpoints.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public API; no published request quota

use_cases: look up EPA MPG for a vehicle year/make/model
list available model years for fuel economy data
get vehicle options by year and make
fetch detailed fuel economy specs by vehicle ID
compare emissions ratings across US vehicles
